sessions.title: VCunder35: networking for young VCs
sessions.description: Exclusive networking event for the new generation of venture capital investors and professionals, bringing together young investors from the international VC community. Organised by Growth Capital, OGR Torino and Ring Capital.
sessions.booking: Exclusive event for young VCs; reservation available on the OGR Torino website.

sessions.title: .WAV by Recall: official closing party
